Meet the Baker

Hi, I’m Edith

I started Cakes by Edith because I believe every celebration deserves a cake that’s as beautiful as the moment itself. I make custom cakes, pan dulce, and teach cake decorating classes right here in Utah — each one made fresh with real ingredients and a whole lot of love.

From intimate birthday cakes to stunning multi-tier wedding centerpieces, I work with you personally to bring your vision to life. No mass production, no shortcuts. Just real craft, real care, and a really delicious cake.

Edith
Why Choose Edith

Cakes That Taste as Good as They Look

A lot of bakeries make cakes that look great in photos but disappoint at the table. Not here. Every creation is made from scratch with quality ingredients — so the flavor matches the presentation every single time.

Whether you want light chantilly cream, rich chocolate layers, or a tres leches-inspired filling — Edith makes it exactly the way you want it.
